provenance.historicalPilotUse: stage-relative failure-point selection only; no historical performance result contributes to the v1 effect estimate, weights, confidence interval, or economics

targetDeployment.source: Apache Iceberg tables pinned to explicit snapshot ids
targetDeployment.shuffleProvider: Apache Celeborn real durable remote-shuffle candidate

cohort.shape: scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> tenant-partitioned Window -> small result reduction
scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> dimension-partitioned Window -> small result reduction
selective scan/filter/project -> single-partition exchange -> global Window -> small result reduction
fact scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> sort-merge join -> global aggregate
fact scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> sort-merge join -> later fresh aggregate shuffle
sparse scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> Window, stressing empty blocks

failurePoints.name: pre-publication
failurePoints.rule: producer computation has completed but durable publication has not become visible

failurePoints.name: post-publication-early
failurePoints.rule: durable publication is visible before any downstream post-exchange stage completes

failurePoints.name: post-publication-middle
failurePoints.rule: first material downstream stage after the target exchange has completed

failurePoints.name: post-publication-late
failurePoints.rule: immediately before the final material downstream stage is launched

primaryPlanPolicy.aqe: tested Spark default; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.shufflePartitions: tested Spark default of 200; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.broadcastThresholds: tested Spark defaults; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.forcedPlanSettings: mechanism-only and excluded from primary aggregate gates

trialPolicy.cacheWarmth: natural backend warmth; no manual cache flush in primary campaign
trialPolicy.recoveryTimeoutWhenControlCorrect: use observed control time and score recovery as 1800 seconds
trialPolicy.controlFailureWhenRecoveryCorrect: score both arms as 1800 seconds for zero speedup credit; retain actual recovery observation separately and count control failure against reliability
trialPolicy.bothFail: score both arms as 1800 seconds for zero speedup credit and count against reliability
trialPolicy.scenarioMassPerCell: workload weight * failure-point weight * input-scale weight

statistics.aggregateMetric: 1 - weighted_sum(recovery failure-to-correct-result ms) / weighted_sum(control failure-to-correct-result ms)
statistics.confidence: paired stratified bootstrap over the 12 scored pairs within every fixed workload/input-scale/failure-point cell; never resample workload identities
statistics.scenarioComposition: fixed workload weights * fixed failure-point weights * fixed 0.25 input-scale weights
statistics.iidUnit: paired repetition within a fixed cell; never physical exchange, map, reducer, or block

costModel.publicationAccounting: charge only bytes and service work introduced by recovery publication; ordinary shuffle writes are reported separately and are not double-counted
costModel.notes: Planning assumptions only; not vendor quotes. Existing-provider and greenfield introduction economics are separate decisions.
